scope: Dry neutral linear PET with one COOH and one OH end; no penetrant, ions, branching or crystallinity validation

published.citation: Sangkhawasi et al., All-Atom Molecular Dynamics Simulations on a Single Chain of PET and PEV Polymers, Polymers 2022, 14, 1161.

canonical.license: GNU LGPL v2.1 (GROMACS v2025.3 README and COPYING)

charge_model: Published PET trimer Merz-Kollman (B3LYP/6-31+G(d)); complete head/body/tail assignments, not isolated aromatic-carbon substitution

charge_rounding_correction.reason: Published rounded head/body/tail charges sum to -0.001 e per COOH/OH chain. Correct exactly its unique terminal alcohol oxygen, rather than globally renormalizing all atoms.

atom_types.name: PET_OH_TAIL
atom_types.source: Polymers 2022 S1/S2; tail OH uses recorded rounding correction

origin.source_line: CT     CT     HC      1   110.700    313.800   ; CHARMM 22 parameter file
HC     CT     HC      1   107.800    276.144   ; CHARMM 22 parameter file

impropers.ordering: Central atom is SECOND in explicit ordered tuples; preserve planes IJK/JKL. Do not use Foyer generic permutation or central-first reorder.
impropers.construction: One explicit periodic improper per aromatic or carbonyl center; 8N per chain. XML excludes them; worker constructs them and removes only untyped Foyer candidates after validation.

adaptations: PPPM long-range Coulomb is an STK adaptation; the source paper used shifted 12 A Coulomb. This is not a byte-for-byte or trajectory reproduction.
Missing 1 bond, 6 angles, 7 proper class tuples filled explicitly from fixed GROMACS v2025.3 OPLS-AA; no wildcard force-field fallback or reinterpretation of SI labels.
Canonical planar periodic impropers are added with source and ordered tuples, not silently dropped.
Two canonical RB proper terms have source-rounding constant offsets (~2.39e-6 kcal/mol); writer permits only its existing 5e-6 kcal/mol tolerance.

conversions.bond: source 0.5*k*(r-r0)^2; Foyer k=k_source*4.184*100, r0_A/10; ParmEd/LAMMPS k=k_source/2
conversions.angle: source 0.5*k*(theta-theta0)^2; Foyer k=k_source*4.184, radians; ParmEd/LAMMPS k=k_source/2
conversions.improper: GROMACS periodic E=k*(1+cos(n*phi-phase)); ParmEd phi_k=k/4.184; phase=180 and n=2 => CVFF [phi_k,-1,2]
